a.speaker: port_officer
a.text: There’s your stamp. Keep that report handy. Want directions to the officers who called it in?

choices.text: Why did they ask for me?

d.speaker: port_officer
d.text: Here. Drew you a map on a napkin. That circle is Police. Ask for the Chief.

why.speaker: port_officer
why.text: You were the only result. Good thing you picked up.

again.speaker: port_officer
again.text: Police is marked on your napkin. Open Map whenever you’re ready.
